sourceSheets.name: Official source reconciliation
notes: All 593 printed subject rows across 22 sections retain their physical Name, Team and Rookie cells, including all 100 base numbers. Historical team assignments, accents, literal Minnesota Tmberwolves and Karl Anthony-Towns spellings are retained without correction. All 219 odds categories retain their literal unlabelled ratios; the PDF names neither format nor unit, so separate box configuration does not turn them into per-pack odds. The NIGHT SHADE / Nightshade spelling alias is exact and family-specific. The official January 12 guide confirms January 29, 2026 release despite the 2025-26 product label. Neither checked official page publishes a named numbering ladder; serial limits and exhaustive parallel numbering remain unverified.
Neither the product page nor the checklist spotlight publishes the named parallel numbering ladder; no limits are inferred from other sports, colors, odds or retailer descriptions.
The odds PDF has no printed format or unit heading. The separate Hobby box configuration does not establish a per-pack unit for these ratios.
The checklist prints NIGHT SHADE while the odds print Nightshade. Only that exact source-family spelling alias is reconciled.
Published historical team assignments and literal name/team spellings are retained without updates to current teams.
